name: slack
title: Slack
description: Channels in a connected Slack workspace. Connect Slack first, then invite the bot to each channel and press Verify.

channels.label: Channels
channels.hint: Pick from the channels this workspace has, or type IDs one per line. The ID is what is stored — a renamed channel keeps its ID, and keying on the name would fork its history.

allowed_senders.label: Allowed senders
allowed_senders.hint: Who may drive the owning agent from this channel — Slack member IDs, one per line. Empty allows nobody.
